subject: ela
intro: In a conversation, we follow rules so everyone can be heard. We take turns, listen when others talk, and stay on the topic. Kindergartners learn to talk and listen in a group.

items.prompt: In a group talk, should you speak all at once or one at a time?

steps: If everyone talks at once, no one can hear.
We take turns and speak one at a time.
So you speak one at a time.

items.prompt: What should you do while someone else is talking?
Your friend is talking about dogs. To stay on topic, what should you talk about?

steps: Staying on topic means talking about the same thing.
So you should talk about dogs too.

items.prompt: When it is not your turn, you should ____.
Talking one at a time means we take ____.
Should you shout over your friend?
